reason: The cited code reads the browser tab's recorded requests, filters them, and returns rendered request lines via response.addResult. It does not show arbitrary host code execution, nor any agent-supplied data being sent to an attacker-readable destination. The returned request URLs/lines come from browser/network activity and can be influenced by visited web pages, so attacker-controllable content is supported. Although browser network history can contain sensitive/non-public URLs or metadata, these lines alone do not establish that the data is from authenticated SaaS, local files, intranet, or another defined secret source.
